name: skool-house-style
about: The numbers skool_cut.py edits to. Each value says where it came from: measured (from a reference file), decided (Caleb or the film kit) or inference (Claude's call, change it freely).

output._source: decided: PRODUCTION.md export and audio steps

pauses._source: measured: Nate Herk 2026-10-11, no gap between word starts over 1.0 s, pause median 0.68 s start to start. Nick Saraev 2026-05-11 course, pause median 0.8 s. Pads are inference so word endings don't clip.

retakes._source: decided: PRODUCTION.md says keep the last good take. Matching rule is inference.

mistake._source: decided: Caleb 2026-10-15. Say it after a bad sentence and the cutter drops that sentence and the phrase. Matching is fuzzy (inference) so whisper spellings like F*** that, Kaleb still count.

face._source: measured: Nate face shots median 6.0 s, face width 17 to 21% of frame. decided: PRODUCTION.md punch-in to 115%. inference: 118% so the change reads on a phone, alternate on jump cuts to hide them.

screen._source: measured: Nate non-face runs median 5.5 s, overall shot median 4.8 s. decided: PRODUCTION.md screen zoom 150 to 200% on the prompt box.

text._source: measured by eye on the Nate contact sheet: no running captions, short keyword labels in a pill near the bottom (CLI . COMMAND LINE TOOL, Google cloud project). decided: PRODUCTION.md wants captions for long videos too, so mode full is one flag away.

targets._source: measured: Nate 9.6 cuts a minute, shot median 4.77 s, p90 11.9 s. Ranges are inference. The cutter checks its own output against these.
